subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call - scheduling
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call - scheduling

Hi Alex / Taylor —

Thanks again for the discovery chat this morning — great context on your roadmap and where a Dedicated deployment could help. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in a technical sizing session: 

Recap from discovery:
- Primary use: real-time chat & retrieval-augmented generation for support workflows
- Current traffic: average ~120 QPS across the service, peak bursts up to ~400 QPS (you mentioned)
- Payloads: median ~150 tokens per request, 95th ~420 tokens
- Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end generation < 200ms (you said ideally ~150ms for chat)
- Compliance: plan to use VPC/private deployment; will need SOC2 artifacts and audit log retention details

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) with our Solutions Engineer to map throughput -> GPU footprint and talk autoscaling/burst handling. Can you confirm attendees and pick a slot? Proposed times (PT):
- Thu May 14, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu May 14, 15:00–15:30 PT
- Fri May 15, 14:00–14:45 PT

Please also share any short telemetry you have (7-day QPS, token distribution, concurrent connections) ahead of the call — even a CSV or a short spreadsheet is fine. I attached a quick template we use for prelim numbers.

Attached: prelim_throughput_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If none of those slots work, tell me a couple windows and I’ll coordinate with Marissa to join.

Thanks,
David
David Kim

Hey David —

Thanks for the recap — that matches what we discussed. We can do the deep dive. Prefer May 14 at 10:00 PT (that works for our infra and product folks). Tentative attendee list: myself (Alex – Eng Mgr), Taylor Nguyen (Platform Lead), Priya Shah (SRE) — I can send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Prelim telemetry (very rough):
- 7-day avg QPS: ~120
- Peak sustained QPS: ~200 for traffic spikes, short bursts up to ~400 for spikes
- Avg request payload: ~120 tokens; p95 ~420 tokens
- Concurrency typical: 60–120 concurrent requests; burst to ~350
- Latency target: p95 generation + network < 150ms ideally

We’ll want to include a quick run-through of compliance — please have SOC2 summary and data residency notes ready. Also curious about model options (open/quantized vs hosted proprietary).

May 14 at 10:00 PT works for us. I’ll wait for the invite and any pre-read.

—Alex

Thanks David / Alex — I can take the call on May 14 at 10:00 PT. Confirming attendees: Marissa (SE, Redwood), David (AE), Alex, Taylor, Priya (FintechCo).

Pre-call ask (if you can share ahead of time, it helps us move faster):
- 7-day traffic export (timestamp, requests/sec) or summary metrics (p50/p95 tokens, per-minute QPS)
- A sample of typical request/response token lengths (JSON or CSV)
- Any preferred models (e.g., Llama-2-70b-quant vs. custom fine-tuned) and whether you plan to run multiple model sizes
- Concurrency targets per route and any strict latency SLAs per route

On the call we’ll cover:
- Throughput -> GPU sizing (initial recommended GPU type and count)
- Autoscale strategy and burst handling (queueing, pre-warmed capacity, graceful degradation)
- Quantization and perf tradeoffs for your model choices
- Monitoring/observability artifacts you’ll want to collect (token-level cost, KV cache hit rates, p95 breakdown)

I’ll bring our draft sizing worksheet and an initial projection based on the numbers Alex shared. If you can drop the telemetry to the Drive link (or reply to this thread with the spreadsheet), we’ll populate the worksheet before the call.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marissa Cole
